chain.label: No formal ENG procedures; pilots assigned dual flying/reporting duties
chain.trigger: the pilots' responsibility to perform reporting and visual tracking duties to support their station's ENG operation... the lack of formal procedures for Phoenix-area ENG pilots to follow regarding the conduct of these operations

chain.label: Informal air-to-air position/intentions reporting procedures not rigorously followed
chain.trigger: evidence indicated that these procedures were not rigorously followed on the day of the accident, possibly because of the pilots' additional responsibilities

caused_by.evidence: possibly because of the pilots' additional responsibilities to provide coverage of the ongoing situation on the ground

chain.label: Pilots' last mutual position/altitude coordination occurred about 4 minutes before the collision
chain.trigger: these transmissions...were the last times that the channel 3 and 15 pilots coordinated their helicopter's position or their intentions with each other

caused_by.evidence: these transmissions, which occurred about 4 minutes before the midair collision, were the last times that the channel 3 and 15 pilots coordinated their helicopter's position or their intentions with each other

chain.label: Both pilots failed to see and avoid the other helicopter as attention narrowed to ground reporting duties
chain.trigger: the channel 3 and 15 pilots' reporting and visual tracking duties immediately before the collision likely precluded them from recognizing the proximity of their helicopters at that time

caused_by.evidence: the channel 3 and 15 pilots' reporting and visual tracking duties immediately before the collision likely precluded them from recognizing the proximity of their helicopters at that time
the Safety Board concludes that the channel 3 and 15 helicopters collided because one or both pilots lost awareness of the other helicopter's position

chain.label: Midair collision: main rotor blades of the two helicopters contacted each other
chain.trigger: the yellow blade on the left side of the channel 3 helicopter and the red blade on the right side of the channel 15 helicopter contacted each other about 2 feet from the end of each blade and then separated

caused_by.evidence: the channel 3 and 15 helicopters collided because one or both pilots lost awareness of the other helicopter's position

chain.label: Both helicopters broke apart/lost control and struck the ground
chain.trigger: the helicopter then fragmented in the air and struck the ground in an inverted position...that helicopter entered a nose-down attitude, which it maintained until impacting the ground

caused_by.evidence: After the outboard section of the channel 3 yellow blade separated, that helicopter's main rotor blades deformed and broke the helicopter's tail boom into several pieces. The helicopter then fragmented in the air and struck the ground

chain.label: All four occupants (two pilots, two photographers) were killed
chain.trigger: the occupants on board both helicopters were killed

caused_by.evidence: the cause of death for the ENG pilots and photographers was multiple blunt force injuries
